source: BMW VFC level 2/3 labels from docs/02-data/processed/feedback_rows.csv

car_areas.label: Exterior, design & lighting
car_areas.description: Look of the car from outside, body panels, mirrors, exterior lights, glass and wipers.

car_areas.label: Interior & comfort
car_areas.description: Cabin look and feel, dashboard, console, ambient light, roominess, glass roof, sun protection.

car_areas.label: Seats
car_areas.description: Seat comfort, adjustment, heating/ventilation, massage, memory, headrests, child seats.

car_areas.label: Climate
car_areas.description: Heating, air conditioning, blower, climate controls, heated surfaces.

car_areas.label: Infotainment & HMI
car_areas.description: Screens, operating concept, iDrive, navigation, audio, smartphone mirroring, voice control, displays.

car_areas.label: Connectivity & digital (incl. AI assistant)
car_areas.description: My BMW App, remote functions, digital key, eSIM/Wi-Fi, OTA upgrades, in-car apps, the intelligent personal assistant, phone pairing and charging.

car_areas.label: Driver assistance & safety
car_areas.description: ADAS, parking aids, cameras, warnings, automated driving, airbags, belts, perceived safety.

car_areas.label: Driving dynamics & powertrain
car_areas.description: Engine/motor, acceleration, handling, ride, brakes, steering, transmission, drive modes, tires, start-stop.

car_areas.label: Range, charging & refuelling
car_areas.description: Electric range, charging (public, home, cable, socket), high-voltage battery, fuel tank.

car_areas.label: Practicality & access
car_areas.description: Luggage, storage, doors, tailgate, frunk, keys and access, towing, everyday handling.

car_areas.label: Quality & materials
car_areas.description: Materials, trim, workmanship, cabin quietness, overall build of the body.

aspect_groups.description: Does the feature exist and do its job (incl. missing equipment).
How easy it is to operate; ergonomics; can't switch it off.
Defects, faults, things that stop working.
Power, speed, responsiveness, strength of an effect.
Consumption, efficiency, electric range, charging infrastructure.
Materials, workmanship, damage, leaks, rattles, smells.
